name: CopyFileContents
description: Adds a button to text file attachments to copy their contents
summary: A copy button on text file previews
notes: The copy button sits in a text file's preview and in its "View whole file" window. It copies with a "Copied to clipboard!" toast and shows a check mark for two seconds; a file Qord loaded only the start of (over 50,000 bytes) can't be copied, as upstream says, "File too large to copy".
